blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Visayas will continue to experience cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms on Sunday, October 25, due to the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ). Moderate to heavy rains may trigger flash floods or landslides, state weather bureau Pagasa said in its daily public weather forecast. The eastern sections of the Visayas […]...
